fields.Name: T095 - Record Change History Restore Previous Version
fields.Description: Exercises the restore-preview flow (AllowRestore, RestorePreviewChange/RestorePreviewVisible, RestorePreviewPanelComponent) — a distinct write-oriented code path beyond opening/reading the history panel (T210).

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, click an event row, then 'Open Full Record'. Open the Record Changes drawer via the history (clock) button. If the timeline shows one or more historical change entries and the record is editable, each history row offers a Restore action; click it to open the restore preview panel (which previews the field values that would be restored). Success is the restore preview panel opening and showing the fields/values to be restored — you do NOT need to confirm the restore. If the record has no history, seeing the empty state is acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Record Changes drawer opens with a timeline (or a clear empty state if no history exists)
Where a historical version and a Restore action exist, invoking Restore opens a restore preview panel showing the field values to be restored
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
